about.title: About SchemeSetu
about.description: SchemeSetu helps every Indian citizen discover the government welfare schemes they are entitled to — instantly, privately, in their own language.
about.disclaimer_full: SchemeSetu is an independent, non-government initiative. Results are indicative only. Always verify eligibility at the official scheme portal. SchemeSetu is not responsible for any decisions based on this information.
about.data_note: All scheme data is sourced from official government portals and manually verified. Each scheme shows its last-verified date and verifier.
